phenomenon: 受限终端中的 HDC 命令返回 Connect server failed，被误判为 VM 未启动。
auditScope: 本机进程与 TCP 监听（Emulator:5555、hdc:8710、DevEco 客户端）
DevEco 设备管理器 Mate 80 Pro 行状态
项目 HDC lease 记录与 stale lock
提升权限后的只读目标发现和 guest boot probe

evidence.lsof: Emulator PID 21552 LISTEN 127.0.0.1:5555; hdc PID 75381 LISTEN 127.0.0.1:8710 and connected to 5555; devecostu PID 78563 has two ESTABLISHED clients to 8710
evidence.devecoUi: Mate 80 Pro operation icon is stop (running); warning icon text says system image missing but does not indicate target absence
evidence.restrictedHdc: hdc -s ::ffff:127.0.0.1:8710 list targets -v => Connect server failed
evidence.elevatedHdc: same command with approved elevated host access => 127.0.0.1:5555 TCP Connected localhost
evidence.deployment: latest iteration receipt 20260912T180456Z... deploy-vm-6460677a198b-20260912T182137Z.json install=PASS launch=PASS dataPolicy=preserve

auditConclusion: VM and HDC were healthy. Failure was caused by restricted terminal network permissions plus DevEco shared HDC clients; an interrupted probe also left stale lease metadata. No app/data fault established.
operationContribution: The agent relied on sandbox HDC failures and did not use the elevated host channel, then reported the VM as down.
